name: radial-bar-chart
title: Radial bar chart
description: A React radial bar chart: 2 to 5 concentric KPI rings against their goals, each on its own track. Hover or arrow through rings to read them. Animated, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Radial bar chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/radial-bar-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { RadialBarChart, RadialBarTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/radial-bar-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
